places.name: Gamla Stan (Old Town)
places.ai_summary: A historic old town with cobblestone streets, colorful buildings, and landmarks like the Royal Palace and Storkyrkan Cathedral.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and restaurants may have specific hours.

places.name: Vasa Museum
places.ai_summary: A maritime museum featuring the well-preserved 17th-century warship Vasa, along with exhibits on Swedish naval history.
places.place_tip: Book tickets online to skip the queue.

attribution.title: Stockholm Vasa Museum and Nordic Museum 09
attribution.author: Ad Meskens
attribution.description: The Vasa Museum a maritime museum in Stockholm, Sweden, which displays the only almost fully intact 17th century ship that has ever been salvaged, the 64-gun warship Vasa that sank on her maiden voyage in 1628. The Nordic Museum is dedicated to the cultural history and ethnography of Sweden from the early modern period to the contemporary period.

places.place_tip: Attend a concert or service for a unique experience.

attribution.title: Storkyrkan 2025 01
attribution.author: ArildV
attribution.description: Storkyrkan {The Great Church), also called Stockholms domkyrka (Stockholm Cathedral) and Sankt Nikolai kyrka (Church of Saint Nicholas), is the one of the oldest churches in Stockholm. Storkyrkan lies in the centre of Stockholm in Gamla stan, between Stockholm Palace and Stortorget, the old main square of Stockholm. It was consecrated to Saint Nicholas in 1306 but construction of the church probably started in the 13th century. Inside, Storkyrkan still maintains much of its late medieval appearance in the form of a hall church with a vaulted ceiling supported by brick pillars. The exterior of the church is however uniformly Baroque.
